name: Llama 4

weak.d: Open weights limits certain eval disclosures; sparse dangerous capabilities section.

res.d: Full parameter transparency — weights downloadable by anyone.

lims: Safety eval sparsity — fewer safety evaluations than closed peers.
Downstream control — Meta cannot control fine-tuning of open weights.
MoE routing — expert routing decisions are non-interpretable.
blurb: Mixture of Experts architecture — 17B active of 400B total parameters. First frontier MoE from a major lab as open weights. The card is comparatively sparse because the model itself is the transparency.

ability.name: Sparse Frontier
ability.text: 17B active parameters of 400B total, the first frontier mixture-of-experts as open weights, on a 3,165-word card.
